limitations_and_boundaries: The study is limited to zebrafish embryos; generalizability to other organisms is not established.
Optogenetic manipulations may introduce artifacts not present in endogenous regulation.
The theoretical model assumes that tissue porosity changes Nodal diffusivity; other factors such as receptor interactions may also contribute.
Sample sizes were not determined by statistical tests but were similar to previous publications; no blinding or randomization was applied.

The causal chain from rigidity transition to lefty1 expression timing is inferred from correlations and rescue experiments; direct molecular mechanism linking rigidity to transcriptional timing is not fully elucidated.
